# SkillInfo

[API index](../index)

One observed skill, shared by player, weapon-swap, entity and buff-source lookups.
Scalar facts belong to the lookup frame; read the owner again for updated facts.

**@keywords**

skills, readiness, cooldown, snapshot

## Name

```typescript
Name: string;
```

Skill name used for case-insensitive lookup; empty for an unnamed missing skill.

**@keywords**

skills, name, lookup

## InternalId

```typescript
InternalId: string;
```

Identifier from ActiveSkills.dat, also accepted by Skills[id] and Skills.Has(id).
For example DreadBannerPlayer has InternalId "dread_banner". Empty when its metadata row is unavailable.

**@keywords**

skills, identity, internal id, lookup

## Id

```typescript
Id: number;
```

Primary native skill identifier. Pair it with Id2 for identity.

**@keywords**

skills, identity, lookup

## Id2

```typescript
Id2: number;
```

Secondary native skill identifier. Pair it with Id for identity.

**@keywords**

skills, identity, lookup

## Exists

```typescript
Exists: boolean;
```

Whether the requested skill was found. Clearing its hotbar binding does not remove the equipped skill.
An empty BySlotIndex lookup returns false; lookup by the still-equipped skill's name returns true.

**@keywords**

skills, presence, missing

## CanBeUsed

```typescript
CanBeUsed: boolean;
```

Native flags, cooldown, weapon and mana/life/energy-shield checks.
This existing predicate does not include Glory or every skill-specific restriction; inspect CanBeUsedInUi separately.

**@keywords**

skills, readiness, resources, cooldown

## CanBeUsedInUi

```typescript
CanBeUsedInUi: boolean | null;
```

The game's own hotbar readiness, including skill-specific restrictions.
Returns null without a readable mouse/WASD button; missing skills return false. Read independently of window focus.
The game may leave this flag stale in the background. Look up the skill again to read its current memory value.

**@keywords**

skills, readiness, resources, hotbar, availability

## RequiredGlory

```typescript
RequiredGlory: number | null;
```

Base Glory requirement from active_skill_requires_X_glory; useful for identifying Glory skills.
NOT the effective threshold or maximum after modifiers: Daresso's Passion, for example, grants 50% less Glory required.
Do not infer readiness from Glory >= RequiredGlory or treat Glory / RequiredGlory as the UI percentage; use CanBeUsedInUi.
Zero means the base stat is absent or zero; null means classification is unavailable,
including an unresolved Stats.dat key or a failed live read needed to classify the skill.

**See also**

https://poe2db.tw/us/Daressos_Passion

**@keywords**

skills, banner, glory, requirement, classification

## UsesGlory

```typescript
UsesGlory: boolean | null;
```

Whether the skill declares the Glory resource through active_skill_requires_X_glory.
Cached across ticks until the skill identity/definition, stats container or Stats.dat changes.
Tests stat presence, not its numeric value; requirement-reducing modifiers do not change this classification.
Returns null when the stat definition or live data needed to classify the skill is unavailable.
Failed initial reads are retried. This is not a CanBeUsed predicate.

**@keywords**

skills, glory, resource, classification

## Glory

```typescript
Glory: number | null;
```

Current Glory resource in Glory units, preserving hundredths. This is not the fixed maximum stat.
Returns null for a skill without a Glory entry or when the resource cannot be read.
Modifiers can lower the Glory required for use; neither a fixed threshold nor comparison with RequiredGlory proves readiness.
Use CanBeUsedInUi for the game's button decision.

**Example**

```ts
const glory = World.Skills["DreadBannerPlayer"].Glory;
```

**@keywords**

skills, banner, glory, resource, charges

## DeployedEntities

```typescript
DeployedEntities: Entity[];
```

Entity handles for this skill's deployed objects. Unresolved IDs are omitted; filter IsAlive when counting live summons.
Resolves entities only when read and does not enumerate their skills or buffs.
Returns an empty array after the lookup frame; read the skill again to refresh it.

**@keywords**

skills, summons, totems, deployed, entities

## DeployedObjectEntityIds

```typescript
DeployedObjectEntityIds: number[];
```

Native entity IDs recorded for deployed objects, including IDs no longer resolvable in the world.

**@keywords**

skills, summons, identity, deployed

## Stats

```typescript
Stats: { [index: number]: Stat } & { Has(id: number): boolean };
```

All decoded per-skill stats, indexed by the current game's numeric stat ID, without a selected-stat whitelist.
Values come from this skill's stats container, not the player's aggregate Stats component.
Missing entries have Exists=false and Value=0. Numeric IDs can move between game versions.

**Example**

```ts
const stats = World.Skills["dread_banner"].Stats;
for (const id of Object.keys(stats)) Log(`${id}: ${stats[Number(id)].Value}`);
```

**@keywords**

skills, stats, modifiers, lookup

## StackPercent

```typescript
StackPercent: number;
```

**@keywords**
